name: WF-252 — Underwriting Calibration → Dynamic MAO & Deal Strategy Adjustment

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const calibration_status=String(d.calibration_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const base_mao=Number(d.base_mao??NaN),factor=Number(d.adjustment_factor??1),confidence=String(d.confidence??"low").toLowerCase();const adjusted_mao=Number.isFinite(base_mao)&&Number.isFinite(factor)?base_mao*factor:null;let status="needs_review",reason="Dynamic MAO adjustment requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(calibration_status!=="calibration_ready"){status="calibration_not_ready";reason="Underwriting calibration is not ready.";next="WF-251";}else if(!Number.isFinite(base_mao)||!Number.isFinite(factor)){status="invalid_adjustment";reason="Base MAO or adjustment factor is invalid.";next="WF-251";}else if(confidence==="low"){status="low_confidence";reason="Low-confidence calibration cannot autonomously change MAO.";next="WF-126";}else{status="strategy_adjusted";reason="Dynamic MAO successfully adjusted using calibrated underwriting feedback.";next="WF-253";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-252",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,calibration_status,confidence,base_mao,adjustment_factor:factor,adjusted_mao,status,reason,requires_human_review:status!=="strategy_adjusted",next_workflow:next,strategy:{maO_method:"confidence_weighted_historical_performance",static_70_percent_rule:"secondary_reference_only",residential_multifamily_land:"separate_economic_models"}}}];
